title: The Brars Return by Night and Plot a Pathan Disguise

blocks.text: With the Singhs dominant in the area by day, displaced Brars can only come back at night to look at their abandoned homes and judge what has been lost. The memory is preserved as an ordered account rather than rumor, giving the episode the feel of a remembered local history.

The page then shifts into a new plan of revenge: Resolving to disguise themselves in the guise of Gilja Pathans, the Brars decide that deception will accomplish what open fighting could not. Red robes, borrowed appearance, and calculated fear become tools for another round of conflict.

This transition also serves as the hinge into the next Brar episode, where disguise and surprise replace the previous battle line. The story moves from the aftermath of defeat into a fresh attempt to unsettle and rob the Singhs through impersonation.
